narrative:
Trumbull County has 131,293 registered voters, with 18.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 14.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 53.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 39.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.4% of registrants. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +4.1% D−R vs +20.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
